title: Renal-artery stenting for atherosclerotic renal artery stenosis: physiologic plausibility tested against CORAL hard endpoints
summary: Promotes renal-artery stenting for atherosclerotic renal-artery stenosis as a hard-endpoint procedure-reversal record. CORAL tested whether adding stenting to comprehensive medical therapy improved clinical outcomes in a defined population and found no significant benefit, while the record preserves selected-case guardrails for severe/acute-on-chronic presentations.

claims.claim: The CORAL trial found that renal-artery stenting did not confer a significant benefit for prevention of clinical events when added to comprehensive multifactorial medical therapy for atherosclerotic renal-artery stenosis with hypertension or chronic kidney disease.
what_would_change_status: A corrected CORAL report or higher-quality later trial materially changes the event-benefit conclusion in the parent population.
